title: FORGE reference reconstruction failure catalogue
purpose: retrievable application memory and proposed acceptance checks; not a record of passed tests

cases.observed_failure: R15 changed the preferred R14 head impression and was rejected despite more triangles.
cases.proposed_repair: Preserve accepted head envelope and use registered local edits only.
acceptance_criteria: Report head width/height/depth before and after.
Show front and both oblique silhouettes.
No automatic acceptance from polygon count.

cases.observed_failure: Visible cap edge and roots ending above the forehead break realism.
cases.proposed_repair: Attach roots to scalp and cover exposed cap edge with controlled overlapping growth.
acceptance_criteria: No blunt exposed root ends in front/oblique close-ups.
No open centre trench.
No larger apparent head caused by new root volume.

cases.observed_failure: Repeated thick cylindrical locks replace natural broad waves and fine structure.
cases.proposed_repair: Shape primary waves, secondary clumps and tapered thin strands with bounded irregularity.
acceptance_criteria: Front/profile/back have coherent gravity and wave direction.
No repeated equal-radius rope silhouette.
No isolated strands penetrating the face.

cases.evidence: Latest user instruction; earlier reference has brown/dark hair
cases.observed_failure: Latest art direction requests chestnut on image-left and grey on image-right.
cases.proposed_repair: Assign regions in image coordinates and preserve natural inter-strand variation.
acceptance_criteria: Live side brown/chestnut, skeletal side grey/silver.
Grey is labelled requested deviation from prior reference.
Colour regions survive FBX/GLB export.

cases.observed_failure: Coloured face appears more detailed than its neutral-material geometry.
cases.proposed_repair: Build eyelid opening and seated eyeball with canthus continuity.
acceptance_criteria: Neutral-material eye reads as eye with upper/lower lids.
Eyeball stays behind lid rims.
Expression remains consistent with preferred reference.

cases.observed_failure: Deep uniform dark socket and obvious spherical eye resemble inserted objects.
cases.proposed_repair: Refine orbital walls and brow/zygomatic transitions; keep requested eye recessed.
acceptance_criteria: Eye stays in socket in both profiles.
No perfect tube edge or floating eyelid ring.
Clay and textured views show the same cavity shape.

cases.observed_failure: Repeated small rectangular crowns and abrupt mouth edge produce an artificial smile.
cases.proposed_repair: Use differentiated rounded crowns on a coherent arch and fit to mouth envelope.
acceptance_criteria: Incisors/canines differ visibly where exposed.
No duplicated rows or floating crowns.
No tooth projects through the cheek or lip.
Same smile envelope in textured and clay views.

cases.observed_failure: Nasal opening and adjoining surfaces were jagged and only partly corrected in E16.
cases.proposed_repair: Use connected boundary loops and local surface reconstruction.
acceptance_criteria: No unintended open crack at outer transition.
Nasal wall has depth in side view.
No broad black texture that fakes an absent opening.

cases.observed_failure: Orbit/maxilla/mandible read as disconnected simplified forms.
cases.proposed_repair: Sculpt continuous supporting structures within the accepted head envelope.
acceptance_criteria: Neutral material shows coherent cheek arch and jaw line.
No sharp unsupported patch edge.
Live/skeletal split is deliberate and aligned.

cases.observed_failure: E15 had a step where neck entered jaw; E16 reduced but did not fully validate all angles.
cases.proposed_repair: Fit connected transitions and retain proportional neck length.
acceptance_criteria: No detached ring or horizontal shelf below jaw in front/profile.
No skin colour seam across a continuous intended surface.
Neck silhouette remains plausible from both sides.

cases.observed_failure: Shoulder/neck anatomy and garment-supported bust need clearer shape.
cases.proposed_repair: Use restrained clavicle/neck/torso forms and fit garment jointly.
acceptance_criteria: No tendon represented by a loose cord.
Bust follows garment and reference proportions.
No skin-through-cloth at neckline/axilla.
No inferred hidden anatomy reported as observed.

cases.observed_failure: Some earlier seams floated above the material.
cases.proposed_repair: Project/follow seams on the garment with appropriate relief and consistent thickness.
acceptance_criteria: No floating seam in oblique light.
No slit under sleeve attachment.
Visible neckline and panel seams match garment construction.

cases.observed_failure: Large blotches and regular folds fail to describe cloth weave and fit.
cases.proposed_repair: Separate colour/roughness/normal and use local cloth tension/fold structure.
acceptance_criteria: Ivory and black materials remain distinguishable under neutral light.
Weave scale is consistent across panels.
No texture seam at paired neckline panels.

cases.observed_failure: Pores are requested, but missing anatomy cannot be corrected by noise.
cases.proposed_repair: Use restrained, scale-aware surface detail after structural acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Pores remain microdetail rather than pitted stone.
Roughness responds under changed light direction.
Colour maps do not add new heavy baked lighting.

cases.observed_failure: Native shading/curves can differ from the delivered viewer asset.
cases.proposed_repair: Re-import exported artifact into an empty scene and render it.
acceptance_criteria: Artifact SHA matches manifest.
Actual exported triangles recorded.
Every expected active image exists and loads.
No empty review view.
Units and dimensions documented.

cases.observed_failure: A single frontal image does not provide hidden-side and back geometry.
cases.proposed_repair: Track visibility and mark reconstructed unseen areas as interpretation.
acceptance_criteria: Front coverage mask saved.
No exact reconstruction claim for hidden surfaces.
Back view shown for continuity review.

cases.evidence: Inspected private ChessArena board visualizer and layout contract; source links in research-e17/CHESS-TRAINING-TRANSFER-E17.md
cases.observed_failure: User reports wrong square colours and alternating pattern from earlier generation.
cases.proposed_repair: Preserve exact 8×8×8 indexing and ((X+Y+Z)&1)==0 colour convention; test material and rendered output.
acceptance_criteria: Expected cell count and level count exact.
Each adjacent cell changes parity per specification.
Camera projection/lighting does not conceal the test.

cases.evidence: User-reported earlier observation, not independently reproduced
cases.observed_failure: User reports better fan geometry in an earlier Astra/Blender attempt.
cases.proposed_repair: Keep as a targeted reproducible case: count ribs, verify pivot, span and hand contact.
acceptance_criteria: Original reference and both compared assets identified.
Rib count/span/pivot measured from the case specification.
No public superiority claim from memory alone.

cases.observed_failure: Prompt/context improvements can be misdescribed as training model weights.
cases.proposed_repair: Separate case memory, retrieval, evaluations and actual checkpoint training records.
acceptance_criteria: No retrained-Astra claim without supported weight-training run.
Data manifest and held-out results linked for any actual training claim.
Synthetic or mocked evaluations clearly labelled.

cases.observed_failure: Saving a prompt or quote draft can be confused with confirmed production.
cases.proposed_repair: Use distinct draft, reviewed, quoted, accepted and production states.
acceptance_criteria: No invented supplier rates.
Preview is not an accepted order.
Price currency, material usage and process assumptions visible.

training_evidence_boundary: Repository source and CPU smoke found; completed L4 visual training summary and neural weights not recovered from the reviewed tree. Earlier VM artifacts not inspected.
